author: Fouled
body:
Hello,

The Map Development team has been working on a new hub for a few days now, considering the current hub has a few errors and flaws within the boundary. We thought we might try out a new hub which will hopefully last longer. It will be added as the official hub sometime tonight, so stay tuned!

NOTE: If there are any errors in the hub, feel free to post below!

Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/jjoeu (looks much better in-game)
